description: goo 2026-07-29 (harness ปิดวง, PR-1 tripwire): the 3 existing workflows (ci/design-verify/secret-scan) trigger on pull_request ONLY, so a DIRECT push to main runs nothing — on 2026-07-29 main sat red ~20min unnoticed, and a bug-ledger entry with a dead enforced_by anchor sailed through because no one ran the checker. .github/workflows/main-guard.yml adds `on: push branches:[main]` with job A (tsc + verify-ledger-integrity WITH the explicit path arg — bare run exits 1 not 0, verified, so never a silent pass) and job B (provenance: HEAD on main must be a GitHub PR-merge commit). Bug-class the anchor owns: a direct push masquerading as (or being mistaken for) a legitimate main move. isPrMergeCommit(subject,parentCount) is the SINGLE source of job B's decision (the YAML calls scripts/assert-main-provenance.ts which exports it — no shell/TS drift): requires BOTH 2+ parents AND the generated subject /^Merge pull request #<n> from /, so a linear direct push (1 parent), a locally-crafted `git merge` pushed direct (2 parents, non-PR subject), and a 1-parent commit wearing a fake merge subject are ALL rejected; a real PR merge passes. HONEST SCOPE (not papered): catches accidental direct pushes, not a crafted-subject spoof; not a required check (would block PRs); the GitHub Actions run fires only when main actually moves (post-merge) — pre-merge the RED path is proven locally by mutation. Teeth (npx tsx scripts/main-guard.test.ts): 6/6; job A dead-anchor mutation (enforced_by → nonexistent anchor) → verify-ledger exit 1 = RED, reverted → exit 0; job B on real HEAD a907c12 (PR merge) → exit 0 GREEN, and the 1-parent feature-commit HEAD → exit 1 RED. gate_layer=ci/tripwire+provenance.
